description: University of Texas at San Antonio researchers publish a dataset supporting analysis of pedestrian and cyclist crashes. Zenodo provides an archive free under CC BY 4.0. The study description identifies crash reports, severe-injury outcomes, road and intersection locations, driver and traveller characteristics, lighting, speed limit, road class, collision type and weather. These observations can calibrate safety and exposure components in walking and cycling simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this San Antonio collection. Coverage is the target city and reporting period, which the summary does not specify. Crash reports omit unreported incidents, while hotspots and regression associations do not establish that proposed countermeasures would cause a specific benefit. The internal archive format and source denominators remain unverified. No data archive was downloaded or risk model refitted.
